en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large, ornate two‑storey villa or civic building in a landscaped park. The structure has light brick walls with strong stone corner quoins, a low hipped roof edged by a decorative balustrade, and symmetrical windows with classical pediments. A curved entrance canopy projects above a grand staircase with stone balustrades, leading from a gravel drive bordered by small palms and shrubs. Mature trees and dense foliage frame the view, suggesting a city park or garden setting. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the image side.
